commits.headline: feat(pal): match func_PAL_L09_0040FD68 and func_PAL_L00_003B9E80 with -frac2-keep-user-copies (#458)
commits.author: gelatinous-bullion
commits.body:
* feat(compiler): add the opt-in -frac2-keep-user-copies

Keep a register copy into a user variable through cse and combine: cse
makes a user variable that joins an equivalence class of pseudos the
canonical register, and combine does not fold a pseudo copy into one.
The copy then reaches local-alloc, where it is tied to its source and
costs no instruction, and its references count for the source's
quantity.
